summary:
I mined LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M for large transferable units. All 61 screens are used and 54 passed: 50 MLP families of 64 to 1024 units and 4 attention-head groups. Math, code and facts got no passing unit.

**How the large units were built.** Each starts from a seed: an earlier screened unit, or the top-5 attribution units in one layer. It is grown with its weight neighbours, ranked by |cos| of the w1 gate row plus |cos| of the w2 output column against the seeds. Two subtractions made the large versions pass:
- **Confounding skills:** subtract similarity to other skills' seeds in the same layer.
- **Hub units:** subtract units that recur in 3 or more of my families in a layer. These hubs cause the facts, general_text and month leaks. With them removed, families stay selective at 1024 units: pronoun L14 .696, weekday L13 .489, comparative L9 .402, past tense L11 .356, antonym L8 .737.

**Passing MLP families** (drop on the target):
- **antonym:** L8 at 64 to 1024 (.73–.80); L13 at 128 and 256 (.18–.20).
- **comparative_adjective:**
  - L8: 64 and 256 (.64–.69)
  - L9: 64 to 1024 (.38–.44)
  - L11: 64 to 512 (.57–.69)
  - L13: 64 to 512 (.22–.38)
  - L15: 64 to 256 (.16–.20)
- **irregular_past_tense:** L11 at 64 to 1024 (.28–.36); L14 at 64 to 512 (.27–.42).
- **pronoun_gender:** L13 at 64 to 512 (.38–.45); L14 at 256, 512 and 1024 (.64–.70).
- **weekday_successor:** L13 at 64 to 1024 (.38–.49).
- **month_successor:** L8 at 64 to 512 (.64–.74); L12 at 64 (.26).
- **numberword_successor:** L14 at 256 (.196).

**Passing head groups:**
- multilingual, L2 heads [2,9,12,15] (.435) and [2,3,9,12,15] (.519). Random 5-head L2 sets also drop multilingual by up to .48, so this is weaker evidence.
- comparative, L14 heads [10,11,12,13] (.47).
- month, L5 heads [12,13,14,15] (.846).

**What failed:**
- L8 heads 4–7 (antonym) and L12 heads [1,2,3,12] (pronoun): random head sets in those layers break the targets as much.
- Month families at L9, L10 and L13 failed the held-out check.

**Negative findings:**
- **No selective blocks:** knocking out any single layer drops several skills by .3–.9.
- **Math, code and facts don't localise into MLP families or clean head groups,** even with hub subtraction:
  - math: at most .01 from digit-writer and digit-detector clusters.
  - facts: at most .06.
  - code: at most .05.
- **Math head is a copy head:** L12 head 15 drops math .49 but also month .79 and month's copy control .63.
- **object_colour has no large unit:** about .14 in MLP families, about .26 in leaky L14 head groups.

**Tool limits:** scan handles cap at 20 units, so large parts must be built in the sandbox. The agent-defined skill cap was already reached.
